## ENDORSEMENTS
The following individuals and organizations have endorsed Rachel to continue as the SRVUSD Governing Board Member for Area 5.
Titles/Positions are included for identification only; they do not indicate or imply organizational endorsement.
#### Individuals:
Candace Andersen - Contra Costa County Supervisor, District 2
Andy Li - Contra Costa Community College District Governing Board Member
Sarah Butler - Contra Costa County Governing Board President & Area 2 Trustee
Susanna Ordway - San Ramon Valley Unified School District Governing Board President
Jesse vanZee - San Ramon Valley Unified School District Governing Board Vice President
Laura Bratt - San Ramon Valley Unified School District Governing Board Member
Luz Gomez - East Bay Municipal Water District Director, Ward 2
Michelle Lee - San Ramon Valley Fire District Director
Mark Armstrong - San Ramon Mayor
Richard Adler - San Ramon Councilmember, District 2
Newell Arnerich - Danville Mayor
Mark Belotz - Danville Councilmember
Robert Storer - Danville Councilmember
Karen Sakata - Former Contra Costa County Superintendent of Schools
Bill Clarkson - Former San Ramon Mayor
Scott Perkins - Former San Ramon Councilmember
Julia Oseland - San Ramon Parks & Community Services Commission Chair
Steve Bried - San Ramon Parks & Community Services Commissioner
Kyle Levy - San Ramon Parks & Community Services Commissioner
Vasanth Shetty - San Ramon Parks & Community Services Commissioner
​
Kathy Chiverton - Community Volunteer
Kyle Costamagna - SRVUSD Teacher
Robert Combs - Community Volunteer & Realtor
John & Tena Gallagher - Retired Small Business Owners
Bahareh Heidarzadeh - Principal and San Ramon Office Leader, ENGEO, Inc.
Alec Hurd - Community Volunteer
Rob Maser - Community Volunteer
Alex Mehran Jr. - President & CEO, Sunset Development/Bishop Ranch
Kay Wang - Former Principal of Bay Valley Chinese School
​

Gary Alpert
